Systeme.io has four plans based primarily on contact limits. Free: 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 course. Startup ($17/month): 5,000 contacts, 10 sales funnels, 5 courses. Webinar ($47/month): 10,000 contacts, 50 sales funnels, 20 courses, plus evergreen webinars. Unlimited ($97/month): unlimited contacts, funnels, courses and automation rules.

Does systeme.io have a free plan and what are its limits?
Yes, the free plan supports up to 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 blog, 1 course, 1 affiliate program, and 1 custom domain. Emails sent are unlimited. The free plan never expires and does not require a credit card. Other features have lower limits on the free plan, like 1 automation rule, 1 email campaign and 500 students. If you need more, the Startup plan at $17/month is the next step.

title: Free Plan Limits and Paid Plans
snippet:
Systeme.io pricing in 2026: a free plan for 2,000 contacts, then Startup $17, Webinar $47 and Unlimited $97 a month, or $170 to $970 a year.

Systeme.io is **free for up to 2,000 contacts**, then costs $17/mo for Startup, $47/mo for Webinar and $97/mo for Unlimited on monthly billing. Annual billing prints as $170, $470 and $970 a year, which Systeme.io sells as two months free. A custom Teams plan is quoted, and no plan charges a transaction fee.

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing | Contacts | Funnels | Automation rules | Courses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | 2,000 | 3 | 1 | 1 |
| Startup | $17/mo | $170/yr | 5,000 | 10 | 10 | 5 |
| Webinar | $47/mo | $470/yr | 10,000 | 50 | 100 | 20 |
| Unlimited | $97/mo | $970/yr | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| For teams | Custom | Custom | Everything in Unlimited | Plus a dedicated success manager | | |
Three things hold on every plan, free included. Emails sent are unlimited, file storage is unlimited, and the transaction fee is 0% on payments taken through Stripe or PayPal. The pricing page also lists unlimited sub-accounts on every plan, each with the same limits as the main account.

**Systeme.io is the cheapest of the three at every list size up to 10,000 contacts, and the only one with a free plan.**

| Need | Systeme.io | ClickFunnels | Kajabi |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry plan, monthly | Startup $17: 5,000 contacts | Launch $97: 10K contacts, 50K emails a month | Basic $179: 2,500 contacts, 5 products |
| Entry plan, annual (per month) | $170 a year | $81/mo | $143/mo |
| About 10,000 contacts, monthly | Webinar $47 | Launch, same plan as above | Growth $249: 25,000 contacts |
| Free plan | Yes, 2,000 contacts | No | No |

Systeme.io answers part of that with unlimited assistant accounts on every plan and API access whose rate limit rises from 30 requests a minute on Free to unlimited on Unlimited.

Yes. The free plan never expires and needs no credit card. It includes up to 2,000 contacts, 3 funnels, 1 course with up to 500 students, unlimited emails and 0% transaction fees, but only 1 tag, 1 automation rule and 1 email campaign.

title: Systeme.io Pricing 2026: All 4 Plans Compared (Free to Unlimited)
snippet:
| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Contacts | Funnels | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | 2,000 | 3 | Testing the platform or running a small list |
| Startup | $17/mo | $170/yr ($14.17/mo) | 5,000 | 10 | Solo creators with growing lists and a few products |
| Webinar | $47/mo | $470/yr ($39.17/mo) | 10,000 | 50 | Anyone running evergreen webinars or larger funnels |
| Unlimited | $97/mo | $970/yr ($80.83/mo) | Unlimited | Unlimited | Established businesses with no caps to worry about |
Annual billing on any paid plan is a flat 2 months free (about 17% off) and includes free migration from another platform. There are no transaction fees on any tier, including the free plan, which is genuinely rare in the all-in-one marketing space.
## Free Plan: What You Actually Get
The free plan is the headline feature of Systeme.io’s pricing. Most all-in-one platforms either do not offer a free tier at all or limit it so heavily that it is closer to a trial. Systeme.io’s free plan is a real plan that you can run a small business on indefinitely.
What the free plan includes:
- Up to 2,000 email contacts
- Unlimited emails sent (no monthly send cap)
- 3 sales funnels
- 1 automation rule
- 1 custom domain
- 1 online course (with up to 500 students)
- 1 community
- 1 email campaign and unlimited newsletters
- 1 mobile-optimized “link in bio” page and creator store
- 0% transaction fees on physical and digital products
- 24/7 email support
What the free plan does *not* include:
- More than one automation rule (this is the most common reason people upgrade)
- Evergreen webinars (Webinar plan and up only)
- Free migration assistance (annual paid plans only)
- Early access to new features (Unlimited only)
- The 1-on-1 kickstart coaching session (paid plans only)

Annual billing is straightforward: you pay 10 months for 12 months of service, which works out to about 17% off the monthly rate. The annual prices are flat:
- Startup: $170/year (effective $14.17/month)
- Webinar: $470/year (effective $39.17/month)
- Unlimited: $970/year (effective $80.83/month)

- **API rate limits:** 30 requests/min on Free, 60 on Startup, 120 on Webinar, unlimited on Unlimited. Only matters if you are integrating heavily through Zapier or custom code.

**[Start with Systeme.io’s free plan](https://emailforbeginners.com/go/systeme)** (2,000 contacts, no credit card required, no time limit).

title: systeme.io integrations: Stripe, PayPal and the API
snippet:
**Quick answer**Integrations for systeme.io start with Stripe and PayPal on every plan and an API capped by requests per minute: 30 on the Free plan and 60 on Startup.
## What connects, and on which plan
On systeme.io, the Stripe and PayPal integrations are on all four plans. The API allows 30 requests a minute on Free, 60 on Startup, 120 on Webinar and Unlimited on the Unlimited plan.

The systeme.io free plan allows 30 API requests a minute and connects Stripe and PayPal.

Startup is $17 a month, billed monthly, as read on October 6, 2026; every plan is on [systeme.io pricing](/systeme-io-pricing).
